findings.claim: Tenant adapter fabricates sellable stock and snapshots live catalog data — The new adapter maps every missing/non-number p.stock to existenciaTerminada: 99 and every reservation count to 0 (lines 29-30), then passes the result as catalogoInicial. usePanaderiaMostrador consumes catalogoInicial only inside a one-time useState initializer (lines 36-40), so subsequent Zustand/RTDB hydration and stock changes are ignored.

Checkout closes sales before physical ticket confirmation — cobrarVentaDirecta immediately creates a pedido with estado: 'cobrado' (line 246), decrements local inventory, appends the order, clears the cart, and writes an in-memory ledger event. The new screen directly invokes this function from “Cobrar y Entregar”; no spooler/print result participates in the transition.

State updater performs replayable inventory and ledger side effects — Inside the functional setPedidos updater, the changed code calls setInventario for completion/cancellation (lines 302 and 318) and registrarEvento/setLedger (line 339). React updater functions must be pure and may be replayed or invoked twice under Strict Mode, which can restore/decrement stock and append ledger events more than once.

Production slot override selection is unreachable — The new RenderSlot invocation supplies only baseComponent, componentProps, fallbackComponent, resetKey, and slotId; TarjetaPanProps exposes no resolved override. The candidate's resolveSlotOverride usage exists only in tests, and slotRegistry.ts defines a factory rather than a production allowlist. Consequently ComponenteSeleccionado is always the base component.

Resolver accepts array elements whose types contradict the default — For arrays, resolverValor validates only Array.isArray and returns clonarValorRemoto for the complete remote array. clonarValorRemoto preserves arbitrary primitive/object element types, so a default string[] such as ['base'] accepts [42] when schema is omitted, despite the required base-type matching.

Nullable defaults can never receive valid non-null overrides — resolverValor returns null unconditionally whenever valorBase is null, before schema validation. Thus a field typed string | null with a null default discards a valid remote string even when a supplied Zod schema accepts it; the new test explicitly codifies this loss.

Admin menu bypasses tenant feature gating and validated deletion — The diff removes useAdminFeatures and the featureEnabled('admin_menu_add_category') guard, making the add-category FAB unconditional. It also replaces eliminarProductoConValidacion with eliminarProducto at line 293, changing the destructive behavior beyond presentation-only refactoring.

Filtering the catalog silently disables cart increments — The hook returns inventarioFiltrado as inventario (usePanaderiaMostrador line 364), and the cart increment handler searches that filtered array for the original product. After changing search/category so a cart item is hidden, the lookup returns undefined and pressing + does nothing.

FAB actions are dropped when the closing animation is interrupted — The changed handler no longer invokes item.onPress immediately; it invokes it only when the withTiming completion callback receives finished === true. Any cancellation/interruption of the animation therefore consumes the user tap without executing its action.
